description: VVV - Antennes et liaisons des itinéraires du SRIT Picardie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo2france.fr. The finest level of segmentation which concerns only antennas and links of SRIT routes of the ex-region Picardie. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "VVV — Antennes and routes of the SRIT Picardie" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include VVV, Véloroute, Vélo, Veloroute, Véloroute voie verte, Voie verte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
